overall: The AG found the Rowley Board of Water Commissioners violated the Open Meeting Law on both executive session allegations from its September 11, 2015 meeting, adopting the reasoning of OML 2016-21 and resolving the complaint by informal action with no separate order.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board entered executive session on September 11, 2015 without a valid statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated in that determination, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to follow proper procedure when convening in executive session at the same September 11, 2015 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated in that determination, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law.
